description: Collect Freelancer.com projects by keyword, category or direct project URL/id, with fixed/hourly budgets, skills, languages, bids, employer details and dates.

budgetMax.description: Maximum fixed budget or hourly rate in USD. Use 0 for no maximum. When projectType=any, the range is applied to both types.
budgetMax.title: Maximum budget (USD)

budgetMin.description: Minimum fixed budget or hourly rate in USD. Use 0 for no minimum. When projectType=any, the range is applied to both types.
budgetMin.title: Minimum budget (USD)

categoryUrls.description: Freelancer /jobs/<skill>/ URLs or skill slugs used in mode=byCategory, e.g. https://www.freelancer.com/jobs/python/ or `website-design`.
categoryUrls.title: Category or skill URLs

includeBids.description: Fetch individual bids with bidder identity, amount, delivery period and proposal text. Adds one request per project.
includeBids.title: Fetch bid lists

includeClosed.description: Also search closed projects in search/category modes. Direct project URLs and ids always work for closed projects.
includeClosed.title: Include closed projects

includeDetails.description: Fetch the public project page for employer country/rating/reviews, verification flags, page title and posting text. Adds one request per project.
includeDetails.title: Fetch project details

maxBidCount.description: Only keep projects with at most this many bids. Use 0 for no maximum.
maxBidCount.title: Maximum bid count

maxBidsPerProject.description: How many individual bids to return per project when `includeBids` is enabled.
maxBidsPerProject.title: Max bids per project

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted project records.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum listing pages to request. Each page contains up to 99 projects.
maxPages.title: Max pages

minBidCount.description: Only keep projects with at least this many bids. Use 0 for no minimum.
minBidCount.title: Minimum bid count

mode.description: How to find projects. `auto` detects the mode from the fields you fill in, `search` uses a keyword, `byProject` uses project URLs/ids, and `byCategory` browses a skill/category page.
mode.title: Mode

postedAfter.description: Only keep projects posted on or after this date. ISO date or datetime, e.g. `2026-01-01` or `2026-01-01T12:00:00Z`.
postedAfter.title: Posted after

postedBefore.description: Only keep projects posted on or before this date. ISO date or datetime, e.g. `2026-12-31` or `2026-12-31T23:59:59Z`.
postedBefore.title: Posted before

projectType.description: Keep fixed-price projects, hourly projects, or both.
projectType.title: Project type

projectUrls.description: Full Freelancer project URLs, paths or numeric project ids used in mode=byProject, e.g. https://www.freelancer.com/projects/python/my-project or 40425363.
projectUrls.title: Project URLs or ids

query.description: Keyword used in mode=search, e.g. `python`, `logo design`, `data entry`. Required for search mode.
query.title: Search keyword

skills.description: Skill names, slugs or numeric ids to narrow the search, e.g. `Python`, `website-design` or `13`.
skills.title: Skills

sortBy.description: Order of search/category results. Ending-soon and budget sorts are applied to the collected candidate pool.
sortBy.title: Sort results

title: Freelancer Project Scraper Input
